entities.summary: Jakub Zbořil is a Czech professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently playing with HC Vítkovice of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He was selected by the Boston Bruins in the first round, 13th overall, at the 2015 NHL entry draft.
